verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot ships extensive built-in agentic capabilities: agent mode in editors, cloud/background agents that plan-explore-execute autonomously, @copilot mentions on PRs, automations, custom agents, and a CLI, all documented first-party. Community evidence corroborates hands-on usage of the assistant delivering real productivity gains, supporting the delegation story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of the newer autonomous cloud-agent/background task delegation (most community evidence predates these agentic features).
